text:
Maria Lopez: Hey all — short notice, I need to swap tonight's oncall (19:00–23:00). Kidcare emergency. I can cover Monday morning (08:00–12:00) in exchange. The shift is non-incident but there are a couple of things to watch. @Zoe @Samir any chance? :pleading_face:
Samir Patel: I can take 19:00–21:00 but I have a hard meeting at 21:00, so can't do the last two hours.
Zoe Kim: I can pick up 21:00–23:00, that should work for me. :thumbsup:
Maria Lopez: @Zoe perfect, thank you! Quick handoff notes:
- Scheduled prod maintenance window (non-critical) at 21:00 for a model roll (expect ~10m). If you see degraded tokens/sec or timeouts, first check the deploy run (see link).
- Common false alert: "gpu-memory-high" spikes when nightly batch jobs start — usually resolves in 2–3 minutes. If it persists >5m, escalate.
- Escalation path: try paging oncall -> if no ack escalate to eng-lead (Priya).
Priya Singh: FYI I set autoscaler to conservative earlier for the dedicated pool, so scale-ups might be slightly delayed. If you see backlog >300 reqs, manually bump instance count in Console -> Infra -> Pools.
Maria Lopez: Deployment rollback command in case the model rollout errors:
```bash
kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-runtime -n prod
```
Maria Lopez: Also, prefix cache TTL is 30s for the current job; if you see steady latency increase, clear prefix cache for the affected model in the console.
oncall-bot: Swap request recorded: Maria Lopez -> Zoe Kim (2026-06-15 19:00–23:00).
oncall-bot: Reminder: runbook -> https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/oncall-handbook
Samir Patel: Thx for sorting this quickly. @Maria Lopez feel better! :heart:
Maria Lopez: Thanks everyone — updated the rota and left a DM to @Zoe with a couple more notes (log queries, dashboards). I’ll follow up Monday morning for the trade confirmation.
